smc:
getnote tay
        lda patpl,y
        sta PATT
        lda patph,y
        sta PATT + 1
getnote tay
        lda patpl,y
        sta PATT
        sta rd1+1
        sta rd2+1
        sta rd3+1
        sta rd4+1
        lda patph,y
        sta PATT + 1
        sta rd1+2
        sta rd2+2
        sta rd3+2
        sta rd4+2

sta status
        lda #$60
        sta playop
+       rts

lda #%01000000          ; bit 6 = music ready
        sta status

lda #$2c
        sta playop
        lda #%01000000
        sta status
jumps:
dec notec,x
        bmi steptrack
        jmp soundup

dec notec,x
        lda notec,x
        asl
        lda #0
        rol
        asl
        tay
        lda jtab,y
        sta jvec
        lda jtab+1,y
        sta jvec+1
        jmp (jvec)
jtab    !wo soundup, steptrack

lda pdir,x              ; which direction
        bne +
lda pdir,x
        beq pd0
        lda #2
pd0     tay
        lda ptab+1,y
        pha
        lda ptab,y
        pha
        ldy instroff
        rts
ptab    !wo pdup-1, pddown-1
pdup
illegal:
musicon ldx #2
        dec tempoc
        bpl mainloop
        lda tempo
        sta tempoc
mainloop

musicon dec tempoc
        bpl tdone
        lax tempo
        sax tempoc
tdone   ldx #2
mainloop
